summary.text: A 19-year-old male with genetically confirmed Duchenne muscular dystrophy was transferred to adult cardiology; he was non-ambulatory with intermittent nocturnal NIV and LVEF 42% without heart failure symptoms. Three months later he had STEMI with concomitant atrial fibrillation treated with thrombectomy and sinus conversion; GDMT was continued for a year, and on 5 November 2020 he presented with severe dyspnea and was discharged after short-term dobutamine, then became dobutamine-dependent after 2 more HF hospitalizations.

With severe scoliosis, heart transplantation or LVAD was considered; after MDT discussion, a HeartMate 3 LVAD was implanted on 2020-12-31 (INTERMACS 2, preoperative LVEF 24%, NT-proBNP 3,769 pg/mL) with successful extubation, and NIV-dependent time fell to under one-tenth of the prior duration.

Table 1 lists early RV failure and severe tricuspid regurgitation, complete inotropic-off at POD 64 and discharge on POD 69 (hospital day 108); about 2 years after implantation de novo aortic regurgitation with low cardiac output symptoms was relieved by raising RPM from 4,800 to 5,400. He is listed as alive, with a chest X-ray at 56 months (August 2025).

summary.text: A 29-year-old wheelchair-bound male with DMD on continuous nasal NIV was transferred with severe dyspnea after three HF hospitalizations within 6 months in 2023 despite optimal GDMT; NT-proBNP was 2,902 pg/mL with right pleural effusion on chest X-ray.

On hospital day 15, the scheduled day for LVAD implantation, he had cardiac arrest and E-CPR (20 min) with intubation and VA-ECMO; a right pneumothorax needed a chest tube; a HeartMate 3 LVAD was implanted the next day (Table 1: 2023.05.16, INTERMACS 1).

Postoperatively he had fluctuating RV dysfunction/early RV failure, a left pneumothorax, difficulty weaning inotropes (Table 1 inotropic-off POD 51), a four-month hospitalization with tracheostomy and home ventilator, and a low INR 1.1 to 1.2 from POD 90. On POD 122 he had a sudden mental-status decrease with a right intracerebral hemorrhage; the family declined further surgery and he died the next day (POD 123).

summary.text: A 23-year-old wheelchair-bound male with DMD, not using NIV, was referred to adult cardiology with NT-proBNP 2,414 pg/mL and LVEF 28%; GDMT was uptitrated and ICD evaluation was planned depending on response.

Three months later (31 Aug 2023) he was admitted to the ICU with severe dyspnea, right pleural effusion and pulmonary edema; dobutamine 3 mcg/kg/min was started, he developed shock the next day, ECMO was started with difficult cannulation, E-CPR for recurrent cardiac arrest and intubation, and the LVAD application was approved after eight days.

A HeartMate 3 LVAD was implanted the day after approval (Table 1: 2023.09.14); he was extubated 2 days postoperatively, had mild RV failure (Table 1), inotropic-off at POD 5, major duodenal ulcer bleeding on POD 21 with warfarin skipped, and was discharged on POD 174 without symptoms or complications; he is listed as alive with no late complication.
